Sometimes there are not enough little beads. Meet the small friends. 1 and 4 make 5. 2 and 3 make 5.
We have 4. Add 1, but no little bead is free. The small friend of 1 is 4. So pull down 5 and take away 4. Now it shows 5.
We have 3. Add 2. The small friend of 2 is 3. Pull down 5, take away 3. Now it shows 5.
Good start, Bixi pulled the 5 down. Now, which friend do we take away for the 1? Show Bixi.
Your turn. Show 4 and add 2.
Not enough little beads? Use 5 and take away the small friend.
Taking away with small friends. Take the 5 away, then add back the small friend.
We have 5. Take away 1. The 1-beads are not there. The small friend of 1 is 4. Take away 5 and add back 4. Now it shows 4.
We have 6. Take away 2. The small friend of 2 is 3. Take away 5, add back 3. Now it shows 4.
Your turn. Show 7, then take away 3.
Take the 5 away, then add back the small friend. Do not forget the friend.
When the rod is full, call a big friend. Add 10 next door and take away the big friend. 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6 make 10.
We have 8. Add 9. No room. The big friend of 9 is 1. Add 10 on the next rod, take away 1. Now it shows 17.
We have 7. Add 8. The big friend of 8 is 2. Add 10 next door, take away 2. Now it shows 15.
Bixi took the big friend away. But something is missing next door. What do we add first?
Your turn. Show 4 and add 7.
Big-friend add: 10 next door first, then take the friend away.
The same big-friend trick, with smaller adds. Add 10, take away the big friend.
We have 9. Add 1. No room. The big friend of 1 is 9. Add 10, take away 9. Now it shows 10.
We have 8. Add 2. The big friend of 2 is 8. Add 10, take away 8. Now it shows 10.
Your turn. Show 7 and add 3.
Rod full? Add 10 next door, take the big friend away. Every time.
Taking away with big friends. Take 10 from next door, then add back the big friend.
We have 10. Take away 9. No beads to take here. The big friend of 9 is 1. Take 10 from next door, add back 1. Now it shows 1.
We have 11. Take away 8. The big friend of 8 is 2. Take 10 from next door, add back 2. Now it shows 3.
Your turn. Show 16, then take away 7.
Not enough to take? Borrow 10 next door, then add the big friend back.
The same borrow, with smaller takes. Take 10 next door, add back the big friend.
We have 10. Take away 1. The big friend of 1 is 9. Take 10 from next door, add back 9. Now it shows 9.
We have 11. Take away 2. The big friend of 2 is 8. Take 10 next door, add back 8. Now it shows 9.
Bixi took the 10. We are not finished yet. What do we add back for the 2?
Your turn. Show 10 and take away 3.
Borrow 10, then always add the big friend back. Never stop halfway.
Here both friends work together. Add 10, and take the big friend away using a small friend.
We have 6. Add 7. The big friend of 7 is 3. Add 10 next door. Now take away 3, but no little beads, so take 5 and add 2. Now it shows 13.
We have 5. Add 8. The big friend of 8 is 2. Add 10, then take away 2 with the small friend: take 5, add 3. Now it shows 13.
Bixi is so close. We cannot take 3 little beads, so we use a small friend. How do we take away 3?
Your turn. Show 12 and take away 7.
When the big friend will not come off, let the small friend help inside. Two tricks, one move.
